entry.summary:
Discover why Dr. Luke Bradford and his family fell in love with New Zealand’s lifestyle and never looked back. From working as house officers in local hospitals to owning a successful urban practice and serving as President of the Royal New Zealand College of GPs, Luke’s journey showcases the incredible career growth and outdoor lifestyle available to medical professionals in Aotearoa.

In this video, you’ll explore:

1. A Fulfilling Career Path: Luke shares his journey from house officer to practice owner and his leadership role at the Royal New Zealand College of GPs.

2. Urban GP Practice Insights: Learn about working in a large urban practice like Fifth Avenue Family Practice, managing chronic diseases, and performing minor surgeries.

3. The "NZ Advantage" in Medicine: Why GPs in New Zealand have more autonomy and direct patient management compared to other countries.

4. Ultimate Work-Life Balance: From skiing and fishing to kayaking and hiking the length of New Zealand (Te Araroa trail), discover how Luke balances professional excellence with personal passion.

5. Raising a Family in Paradise: Why New Zealand is the perfect place to raise active, outdoorsy kids and build lifelong memories.

6. Advice for International Doctors: Luke’s top tips for doctors considering a move and why you definitely won’t regret making the leap.

Why Practice General Practice in Tauranga?
Tauranga offers the perfect blend of urban convenience and stunning natural beauty. Whether you’re interested in clinical leadership, specialized medical care, or simply want more time for the things you love, New Zealand provides a professional and personal environment that is hard to beat.

Learn more about GP careers in New Zealand: https://info.health.nz/careers/roles/senior-medical-officers/general-practitioners-rural-hospital-doctors
